learning_outcomes.text: Students acquire knowledge in the field of phenomena and basic operations of heat and momentum transfer, including knowledge for recording and describing various flow conditions using universally applicable balancing methods.
Students are able to analyze the parameters of heat and momentum transfer processes.
Students can apply the acquired knowledge to optimize individual and coupled transport processes for given problems.
They also develop skills to grasp flow effects in laminar and turbulent flows.
They can apply calculation methods to standard problems in mechanical engineering and evaluate the results.
The module imparts both subject-specific and methodological competencies.

syllabus_topics: Introduction, classification of the subject area, importance, history, definition
Material properties and physical properties of fluids: density, viscosity, interfacial tension, speed of sound
Hydro- and aerostatics: liquid pressure in force fields, pressure force on tank walls, buoyancy, swimming stability, aerostatics
Flow of frictionless fluids: streamline theory, static and dynamic pressure, gas dynamics
Flow with friction: conservation laws; balancing as an engineering tool, continuity, momentum, energy
Types of flow: continuum flow, laminar flow, turbulent flow
Pipe flow: laminar flow through pipes; fully developed turbulent flow through smooth and rough pipes; expansions, constrictions and bends, pipe branches; non-circular pipe cross-sections
Flow around bodies: movement of a particle; discussion of drag coefficients, automotive aerodynamics; flow around airfoils
Turbulence modeling and numerical flow calculation: overview of modern flow simulation methods
assessment_rules: The allocation of credit points is granted if the module examination is passed. In the exam, students should explain the underlying elementary phenomena and their relationships for exemplary description methods, select suitable description methods, and apply them adequately. Students should be able to calculate simple problems of heat transfer and fluid mechanics.
